headline: How many more years alone before something changes?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You reached without seeing him and found the worker of the three.
Both hands are busy above the full table.
You asked how many more years pass before something changes. The work already happening is the part I notice first.
The change has not come, and the waiting is already measured in years.
Something keeps the change away while everything else remains active. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what is holding the change…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The card was hidden, but your hand went to the one that's still growing.
Green leaves remain on the living wood above him.
You asked for a count of years. This card makes me look at the growth inside the stillness.
Still, you are alone, and the pause has become a question about years.
Right where the pause would open, something appears. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing on the backs told you, yet you chose the only card in full sun.
The full sun is high behind him.
You asked how many more years you will be alone. This card brings me to full light without a clock.
But connection has not joined the road, and you are asking for the remaining length.
I keep coming back to something between the open road and connection. I don't think it began with you.
Now let's look at what's there…
